name: react-spa

tools.install: install Node.js 22 or later (an LTS release) from https://nodejs.org/ (it includes npm)
npm comes with Node.js: install Node.js 22 or later from https://nodejs.org/ and put its bin folder on PATH

setup: if [ -f package.json ]; then exec npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; fi

checks.name: packages
run: const fs = require('fs'); let lock; try { lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json', 'utf8')); } catch (error) { console.log('no readable package-lock.json: ' + error.message); process.exit(1); } const problems = []; if (!(lock.lockfileVersion >= 2) || typeof lock.packages !== 'object' || lock.packages === null) problems.push('package-lock.json is not lockfile version 2 or 3 (npm 7 or later)'); for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(lock.packages || {})) { if (key === '' || entry.inBundle) continue; const name = key.replace(/^.*node_modules\//, ''); const where = key + ': '; if (!key.startsWith('node_modules/') && !key.includes('/node_modules/')) { problems.push(where + 'a local folder or workspace, whose code the gate does not check'); continue; } if (entry.link) { problems.push(where + 'a link to a local folder'); continue; } const url = 'https://registry.npmjs.org/' + name + '/-/'; if (typeof entry.resolved !== 'string' || !entry.resolved.startsWith(url)) problems.push(where + 'not from the npm registry under its own name (resolved: ' + entry.resolved + ')'); if (typeof entry.integrity !== 'string' || !entry.integrity) problems.push(where + 'no integrity hash'); } if (problems.length) { console.log(problems.join('\n')); process.exit(1); }

checks.name: format
run: config=; for name in .prettierrc .prettierrc.json .prettierrc.json5 .prettierrc.yaml .prettierrc.yml .prettierrc.toml .prettierrc.js .prettierrc.mjs .prettierrc.cjs .prettierrc.ts .prettierrc.mts .prettierrc.cts prettier.config.js prettier.config.mjs prettier.config.cjs prettier.config.ts prettier.config.mts prettier.config.cts; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$config" ]; then set -- --config "$config"; else set -- --no-config; fi; exec node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check --no-editorconfig "$@" .

checks.name: lint
run: config=; for name in eslint.config.js eslint.config.mjs eslint.config.cjs eslint.config.ts eslint.config.mts eslint.config.cts; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$config" ]; then echo 'no ESLint config (eslint.config.*) in the part folder'; exit 1; fi; node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('child_process'); const { ESLint } = require('./node_modules/eslint'); const config = process.argv[1]; const files = execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '-z', '--', '.'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).split('\\0') .filter((file) => /\\.(js|jsx|mjs|cjs|ts|tsx|mts|cts)$/.test(file) && !/(^|\\/)node_modules\\//.test(file)); (async () => { const linter = new ESLint({ overrideConfigFile: config }); const unignored = new ESLint({ overrideConfigFile: config, ignore: false }); const problems = []; for (const file of files) { if (!(await unignored.calculateConfigForFile(file))) { problems.push(file + ': no ESLint config applies to it'); continue; } if (await linter.isPathIgnored(file)) continue; const rules = Object.values((await linter.calculateConfigForFile(file)).rules || {}); if (!rules.some((rule) => ![0, 'off'].includes(Array.isArray(rule) ? rule[0] : rule))) problems.push(file + ': no ESLint rule is on for it'); } if (problems.length) { console.log(problems.join('\\n')); process.exit(1); } })().catch((error) => { console.log(String(error)); process.exit(1); });" "$config" || exit 1; exec node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config "$config" .

checks.name: test
run: config=; for name in vitest.config.ts vitest.config.mts vitest.config.cts vitest.config.js vitest.config.mjs vitest.config.cjs; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$config" ]; then echo 'no Vitest config (vitest.config.*) in the part folder'; exit 1; fi; exec node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config "$config" --allowOnly=false --passWithNoTests=false

count_tests: if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo 0; exit 0; fi; config=; for name in vitest.config.ts vitest.config.mts vitest.config.cts vitest.config.js vitest.config.mjs vitest.config.cjs; do if [ -f "$name" ]; then config=$name; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$config" ]; then echo 'no Vitest config (vitest.config.*) in the part folder'; exit 1; fi; list=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rm -f "$list"' EXIT; out=$(node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs list --config "$config" --json="$list" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 1; }; node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const tests = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8')); if (!Array.isArray(tests)) { console.log('vitest list did not give a list'); process.exit(1); } console.log(tests.length);" "$list"
versions: node --version | sed 's/^/node /'; npm --version | sed 's/^/npm /'; node -e "for (const name of ['vite', 'vitest', 'eslint', 'typescript', 'prettier']) { let version = 'not installed'; try { version = require('./node_modules/' + name + '/package.json').version; } catch {} console.log(name + ' ' + version); }"
